crossRefs.note: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted…

In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name. Declare his doings among the peoples. Proclaim that…
Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahweh…
Pray like this: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory—
One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.
God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.

translations.web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
translations.bsb: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
translations.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
translations.asv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; Let thy glory be above all the earth.
